[[File:Braxas3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Braxas in his wheelchair]]
A '''wheelchair''' was a personal vehicle for people with impaired mobility, similar in function to that of a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|power chair]]. [[Braxas]], a resident of [[Solay]], was known to use a wheelchair.<ref name="SW89">[[Star Wars (1977) 89|''Star Wars'' (1977) 89]]</ref>

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Billey]] used a wheelchair for mobility after refusing [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacements for his spine and lungs following a crash-landing that resulted in severe internal injuries and spinal damage.<ref name="TLCSB">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>
